title: rcbf-prep
description: Performs integration of rCBF as produced by Siemens scanners with FreeSurfer analysis in preparation for group analysis.

outdir.description: Output directory where results will be stored.
outdir.title: Output directory

rcbfvol.description: Input rCBF volume to be registered to the FreeSurfer anatomical.
rcbfvol.title: rCBF volume

subject.description: Subject identifier for FreeSurfer anatomical registration.
subject.title: Subject

roitab.description: ROI table specifying which ROIs will be summarized, e.g., FreeSurferColorLUT.txt.
roitab.title: ROI table

register.description: Registration data file instead of a subject.
register.title: Register file

template.description: Template file used instead of rCBF itself.
template.title: Template file
